mapper.sql: id, reservation_no, user_id, scenic_area_id, spot_id, slot_id, visit_date, start_time, end_time, visitor_count, contact_name, contact_phone, status, source_type, agent_session_code, client_request_id, remark, cancel_reason, cancel_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select from spot_reservation_order where id = #{id} limit 1
select from spot_reservation_order where reservation_no = #{reservationNo} limit 1
select from spot_reservation_order where client_request_id = #{clientRequestId} limit 1

select source_type as sourceType, count(1) as orderCount from spot_reservation_order where visit_date = #{visitDate} and scenic_area_id = #{scenicAreaId} group by source_type order by orderCount desc, source_type asc
select status, count(1) as orderCount from spot_reservation_order where visit_date = #{visitDate} and scenic_area_id = #{scenicAreaId} group by status order by orderCount desc, status asc

select visit_date as date, date_format(visit_date, '%m-%d') as label, count(1) as orderCount, coalesce(sum(visitor_count), 0) as visitorCount from spot_reservation_order where visit_date >= #{startDate} and visit_date <= #{endDate} and scenic_area_id = #{scenicAreaId} group by visit_date, date_format(visit_date, '%m-%d') order by visit_date asc
mapper.insert: insert into spot_reservation_order ( reservation_no, user_id, scenic_area_id, spot_id, slot_id, visit_date, start_time, end_time, visitor_count, contact_name, contact_phone, status, source_type, agent_session_code, client_request_id, remark, cancel_reason, cancel_time, create_time, update_time ) values ( #{reservationNo}, #{userId}, #{scenicAreaId}, #{spotId}, #{slotId}, #{visitDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{visitorCount}, #{contactName}, #{contactPhone}, #{status}, #{sourceType}, #{agentSessionCode}, #{clientRequestId}, #{remark}, #{cancelReason}, #{cancelTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: update spot_reservation_order set status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, cancel_time = now(), update_time = now() where reservation_no = #{reservationNo} and user_id = #{userId} and status in ('PENDING', 'CONFIRMED')
